Ever since the release of iPadOS 26 last year, I’ve missed the earlier days of iPad multitasking. Sure, windowing is cool – but I don’t want that all the time. With iPadOS 26, you’re either all in on windowing, or you can only use apps in full screen. Apple did re-introduce split screen and slideover in later versions, but the features still require you to utilize the windowing system. With iPhone Duo, multitasking feels much more elegant. You can put an app into half of a splitscreen, whilst still seeing your full home screen to select another app. You can also save apps as a pair for swapping into later. iPhone Duo also offers something no iPad offers, the ability to splitscreen a video with an app. On iPad mini, which is very similarly sized to iPhone Duo, this could be excellent.
